With the recent downtime voat has been experiencing, I haven't really had the chance to engage the community here or field suggestions for improvements. @patatoeswizard has taken the initiative and made some useful suggestions for improving the verse, which has spurred me into action.

I see great potential for voat in general and this verse in particular. With or without effort, our subscriber numbers will continue to grow. What we do with that is up to us, but I see this as a verse for educating people and enabling them to learn and explore the wonders of 3D Printing.

To that end, @patatoeswizard made a suggestion that was particularly insightful. That we should have have a 3d printer chart and FAQ similar to what reddit's r/3dprinting has. I think it's an excellent idea. While I don't want to copy exactly what they are doing verbatim, I do feel like it would be helpful to have similar information easily available here.

With that said, I'm asking the /v/3DPrinting community for assistance. First, and most importantly, I need volunteers to help moderate the sub. If you're interested in co-modding, send me a PM and we'll go from there. I do have a moderating style that the folks I pick have to be compatible with, but I am a fairly open-minded person.

Secondly, I need to know how the community would like to see this verse run. Send me your suggestions and ideas.

Finally, I need suggestions for how we might put together and present useful information similar to what r/3dprinting has (without copying and pasting their info) and for improving the information we provide for newbies and veterans alike.

Please, lend me your brain power so we can make this community live up to its immense potential.

-JJEvil
